title: Catrifice Mod
body:
# Catrifice Mod

![Cat on altar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3b08e853f84c26b305d8aed062a07b000bae7cd.png)

Catrifice Mod adds a dark ritual path for turning cats into strange soul-based resources. Build an altar, store the result in a Depressifier, and use Cat Souls to craft bottles, bombs, upgrades, and demon-themed cat variants.

## Features

- **Cat Souls liquid**: a pink liquid with black cat souls drifting through it.
- **Demon Cat Souls liquid**: created when lightning strikes a filled Depressifier, or a lightning rod above one.
- **Cat Soul Altar**: a multiblock ritual structure that captures cat souls when a cat is killed on the center altar block.
- **Depressifier**: stores Cat Souls and Demon Cat Souls, supports bottles and buckets, has upgrade/filter/redstone tools, and visually shows liquid inside the block.
- **Soul bottles**: drinkable Cat Soul Bottle and Demon Cat Soul Bottle items that grant Reincarnation.
- **Reincarnation effect**: lets players survive fatal damage like a totem. Demon soul reincarnation lasts longer and can teleport players to safety near an End portal when used in the End.
- **Demon cats**: crimson and warped demon cat variants, created by touching normal cats with Demon Cat Souls buckets.
- **Wooden Heart drops**: demon cats can drop Wooden Hearts when killed.
- **Cursed bombs**: Weak Cursed Bombs and Heavily Cursed Bombs are TNT-like blocks with stronger custom explosions.
- **Energy and fuel support**: Cat Souls buckets and Demon Cat Souls buckets can be used as long-burning fuel and converted into Redstone Flux-style energy through Team Reborn Energy support.

## Getting Started

Craft and place a **Depressifier** underneath the altar center, then build the altar structure with obsidian on the sides and soul soil or soul sand at the corners. When the altar is complete, kill a cat on the center block to drain Cat Souls into the Depressifier.

Use glass bottles or buckets on the Depressifier to extract stored souls. A full Cat Souls Depressifier can be transformed into Demon Cat Souls by striking it with lightning or by placing a lightning rod above it and letting lightning hit the rod.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Team Reborn Energy

## Notes

This mod is intentionally ritual-focused and a bit cursed. It adds custom liquids, blocks, items, effects, recipes, demon cat variants, and a pixel-art mod icon under the `catrificemod` namespace.
